model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for the Mistralv0.2-Base model, comparing its performance before and after fine-tuning on six medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The horizontal axis, labeled “Per-specialty terms,” lists these six specialties in order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” is scaled linearly from -22 to -27, with tick marks at regular intervals of one unit. For each specialty, there are two bars: a light blue bar representing the base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) and a set of six colored bars representing the model fine-tuned on that specialty, with colors corresponding to the specialty name as indicated in the legend (light peach for Cardio, light orange for Gastro, medium orange for Infect, dark orange for Neuro, dark brown for Obstetrics, and darkest brown for Pediatrics). The base model’s bar is consistently the tallest (least negative) for each specialty, indicating a higher probability. The fine-tuned bars are generally shorter (more negative) than the base model’s bar, indicating lower probability for the corresponding specialty terms. The fine-tuned bars for each specialty are arranged in descending order of negative log probability from left to right, with the darkest brown bar (Pediatrics) being the shortest (most negative) and the lightest peach bar (Cardio) being the tallest (least negative) for each group. The chart does not show any bars with special visual emphasis such as shading or bolding.
